explanation.tr:
• Evet/hayır soruları: yardımcı fiil + özne + fiil → Do you smoke? Is she coming? Have you finished? Can you swim?
• Wh-soruları: soru kelimesi + yardımcı fiil + özne + fiil → Where do you live? What did she say?
• Özne soruları (who/what özne): yardımcı fiil yok → Who called you? What happened?
• Edatla biten sorular: Who are you talking to? Where are you from? What are you looking for?
• Dolaylı (kibar) sorular: normal cümle sırası → Can you tell me where the station is? (✗ where is the station)
• Question tags: You're tired, aren't you? She doesn't eat meat, does she?
explanation.tk:
• Hawa/ýok soraglary: kömekçi işlik + eýe + işlik → Do you smoke? Is she coming? Have you finished? Can you swim?
• Wh-soraglary: sorag sözi + kömekçi işlik + eýe + işlik → Where do you live? What did she say?
• Eýe soraglary (who/what eýe): kömekçi işlik ýok → Who called you? What happened?
• Sözlem bilen gutarýan soraglar: Who are you talking to? Where are you from? What are you looking for?
• Gytaklaýyn (sypaýy) soraglar: adaty söz tertibi → Can you tell me where the station is? (✗ where is the station)
• Question tags: You're tired, aren't you? She doesn't eat meat, does she?
explanation.ru:
• Общие вопросы: вспомогательный + подлежащее + глагол → Do you smoke? Is she coming? Have you finished? Can you swim?
• Специальные: вопросительное слово + вспомогательный + подлежащее + глагол → Where do you live? What did she say?
• Вопросы к подлежащему (who/what): без вспомогательного → Who called you? What happened?
• С предлогом в конце: Who are you talking to? Where are you from? What are you looking for?
• Косвенные (вежливые): прямой порядок слов → Can you tell me where the station is? (✗ where is the station)
• Разделительные: You're tired, aren't you? She doesn't eat meat, does she?

explanation.tr:
Dolaylı anlatımın üç türü:
• İfadeler: said / told + (that) + zaman kayması → "I'm tired." → She said (that) she was tired.
• Sorular: asked + if/whether (evet-hayır) veya soru kelimesi + NORMAL cümle sırası
  "Are you hungry?" → He asked if I was hungry.
  "Where do you live?" → She asked where I lived. (✗ where did I live)
• Emirler/rica: told / asked + kişi + (not) to + fiil
  "Close the door." → He told me to close the door.
  "Don't be late." → She told us not to be late.
Zaman kayması: present → past, past → past perfect, will → would, can → could
explanation.tk:
Gytaklaýyn gürrüňiň üç görnüşi:
• Habar sözlemleri: said / told + (that) + zaman süýşmesi → "I'm tired." → She said (that) she was tired.
• Soraglar: asked + if/whether (hawa-ýok) ýa-da sorag sözi + ADATY söz tertibi
  "Are you hungry?" → He asked if I was hungry.
  "Where do you live?" → She asked where I lived. (✗ where did I live)
• Buýruklar/haýyş: told / asked + adam + (not) to + işlik
  "Close the door." → He told me to close the door.
  "Don't be late." → She told us not to be late.
Zaman süýşmesi: present → past, past → past perfect, will → would, can → could
explanation.ru:
Три вида косвенной речи:
• Утверждения: said / told + (that) + сдвиг времён → "I'm tired." → She said (that) she was tired.
• Вопросы: asked + if/whether (общий) или вопросительное слово + ПРЯМОЙ порядок слов
  "Are you hungry?" → He asked if I was hungry.
  "Where do you live?" → She asked where I lived. (✗ where did I live)
• Команды/просьбы: told / asked + кому + (not) to + глагол
  "Close the door." → He told me to close the door.
  "Don't be late." → She told us not to be late.
Сдвиг времён: present → past, past → past perfect, will → would, can → could

explanation.tr:
İngilizcede temel cümle sırası: Özne – Fiil – Nesne – Yer – Zaman (S-V-O-P-T)
• I play football in the park on Sundays.
• Fiil ile nesne ayrılmaz: She speaks English very well. (✗ She speaks very well English.)
• Sıklık zarfları: ana fiilden önce, be'den sonra → I always walk. She is always late.
• Sıfatlar isimden önce: a big red car (görüş-boyut-yaş-renk-köken-malzeme sırası: a nice old Turkmen carpet)
• Dolaylı nesne: give someone something / give something to someone → I gave her a book. / I gave a book to her.
• Bağlaçlar: and, but, or, so, because, although
explanation.tk:
Iňlis dilinde esasy söz tertibi: Eýe – Işlik – Doldurgyç – Ýer – Wagt (S-V-O-P-T)
• I play football in the park on Sundays.
• Işlik bilen doldurgyç aýrylmaýar: She speaks English very well. (✗ She speaks very well English.)
• Ýygylyk hallary: esasy işlikden öň, be-den soň → I always walk. She is always late.
• Sypatlar atdan öň: a big red car (pikir-ölçeg-ýaş-reňk-gelip çykyş-material tertibi: a nice old Turkmen carpet)
• Gytaklaýyn doldurgyç: give someone something / give something to someone → I gave her a book. / I gave a book to her.
• Baglaýjylar: and, but, or, so, because, although
explanation.ru:
Базовый порядок слов: Подлежащее – Глагол – Дополнение – Место – Время (S-V-O-P-T)
• I play football in the park on Sundays.
• Глагол и дополнение не разделяются: She speaks English very well. (✗ She speaks very well English.)
• Наречия частоты: перед смысловым глаголом, после be → I always walk. She is always late.
• Прилагательные перед существительным: a big red car (порядок: мнение-размер-возраст-цвет-происхождение-материал: a nice old Turkmen carpet)
• Косвенное дополнение: give someone something / give something to someone → I gave her a book. / I gave a book to her.
• Союзы: and, but, or, so, because, although
